recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless PA makes a new design decision to rename or remodel Location availability; adding a separate Location.notAvailable element now would duplicate the active Availability datatype and conflict with the migration notes.
issue_request: FHIR-17622 asked to rename Location.hoursOfOperation to align with HealthcareService and PractitionerRole availableTime and to add the notAvailable element missing from Location. PA published a Not Persuasive with Modification decision: keep the Location-specific hoursOfOperation name, but add notAvailable support for holidays, planned maintenance, and similar closures.
initial_application: No structural commit explicitly tagged FHIR-17622 was found. Commit 447e89f4a40f92d16f33490766f29b9bce017236 introduced the shared Availability datatype and changed Location.hoursOfOperation to type Availability; commit 7b3274152e23b9f3697c9d303be1be832dd811fa, explicitly tagged FHIR-17622, added Location notes that direct implementers to hoursOfOperation.notAvailableTime for closure exceptions.
additional_context: FHIR-25381 created the shared Availability datatype with availableTime and notAvailableTime children, and FHIR-26641 independently requested Location support for discrete closures. FHIR-32500 later clarified availability rendering language across PractitionerRole, HealthcareService, and Location. source/fhir.ini lists both Location and Availability as active build inputs and records the R5 migration into Location.hoursOfOperation rather than a parallel Location.notAvailable element.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current build-scope source preserves Location.hoursOfOperation and exposes Availability.notAvailableTime.description/during under it, matching the Jira and PA minutes disposition.

related_jiras.note: Created the Availability datatype that now carries Location.availableTime and notAvailableTime details under Location.hoursOfOperation.
